_comment: Modules production code does not import. Several were dead TWINS of a live feature - see the script header. testOnly is worse than unimported: the suite is green on code nothing runs. Do not add entries to make CI pass; delete the module or wire it up. WEB-QUAL-013 emptied `unimported` (19 modules deleted, 1 wired up). TWO ENTRIES WERE STALE, which is worth knowing before trusting this file: queryKeys.ts was listed while SIX hooks import it, and geo.ts was listed as testOnly while production had started importing it. This list is a ratchet - a new entry fails the check, but an entry that stops being true is only removed by re-running --write, so a stale one can sit here for months.
